'''Takehito Koyasu''' (Japanese: '''子安武人''' ''Koyasu Takehito'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. His most prominent role was [[Butch]] of [[Team Rocket]]. He was born on May 5, 1967 in {{wp|Yokohama}}, {{wp|Kanagawa Prefecture|Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}.
